model_suite.input_representation: 31-dimensional tabular feature vector x_last (endpoint step t)
Tensor of shape (batch, 5, 31) representing L=5 temporal sequence

model_suite.architecture: CompactTemporalTransformer(input_dim=31, d_model=32, nhead=4, num_layers=2, dim_feedforward=64, dropout=0.1)
model_suite.input_representation: Tensor of shape (batch, 5, 31) representing L=5 temporal sequence

model_suite.architecture: RepresentationHybridClassifier(Transformer 32-dim pooled embeddings + 31-dim x_last vector -> Random Forest)

primary_metric.name: Macro-F1
primary_metric.role: Primary optimization and ranking metric across all three classes

secondary_window_metrics: Critical Class Precision, Recall, F1 (urgent 15-minute failure horizon)
Warning Class Precision, Recall, F1 (early 30-minute warning horizon)

episode_detection_metrics.definition: A failure episode is detected if any pre-failure window (y in {1, 2}) yields y_pred in {1, 2}
metrics: Episode Recall = Detected Episodes / Total Eligible Episodes
Detection Lead Time = t_fail - t_first_alert (median, IQR, min, max in seconds/minutes)

false_alarm_containment_metrics.name: Pure-Normal Entity False Alarm Rate (Entity FAR)
false_alarm_containment_metrics.formula: Pure-Normal Entities with >= 1 alert / Total Pure-Normal Entities

false_alarm_containment_metrics.name: Pure-Normal Parent-Job False Alarm Rate (Job FAR)
false_alarm_containment_metrics.formula: Pure-Normal Parent Jobs with >= 1 alert / Total Pure-Normal Parent Jobs

false_alarm_containment_metrics.name: Normal-Window False Positive Rate (Window FPR)
false_alarm_containment_metrics.formula: Normal Windows with y_pred in {1, 2} / Total Normal Windows

uncertainty_estimation.resampling_unit: parent_job_id (clusters all windows of sampled jobs together)
uncertainty_estimation.justification: Accounts for intra-cluster correlation across tasks from the same parent job.

gate_1_failure_recall.rationale: Ensures the system catches at least 7 out of 10 failure episodes with sufficient lead time.

gate_2_false_alarm_containment.requirement: Pure-Normal Entity FAR <= 10.0% AND Normal-Window FPR <= 5.0%
gate_2_false_alarm_containment.rationale: Prevents operational alert fatigue across healthy cluster services.

operational_acceptance_gates.winner_determination: A model is declared an OPERATIONAL_WINNER if and only if it passes both Gate 1 and Gate 2. If multiple models pass, the model with the highest Macro-F1 on the Test split wins. If no model passes both gates, the verdict is NO_OPERATIONAL_WINNER.
operational_acceptance_gates.immutability_rule: These gates are predeclared before training and cannot be modified post-hoc.

quarantine_declaration.rationale: Phase 6 confirmatory holdout shares 20 parent jobs (1,727 windows, 32.5%) with dev pool and was repeatedly unblinded. It must NOT be used for model selection or fresh confirmatory claims.
